entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to a person already!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I need to return this helmet I bought. Your online process is a nightmare and I'm not wasting another second on it. I want this handled now.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Michael Sterling. Order number is VF88-19-22-LIMA. And let me be clear, I expect a full refund. No store credit nonsense.

Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling up your order now. I see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong color! It looked like a deep blue online, but it's practically purple. It's hideous. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched the thing. I just want my money back.
I completely understand. Getting a product where the color isn't what you expected is frustrating. Let me just confirm the purchase date here to check the return eligibility...

Don't you dare give me some runaround about a return window! I've had it with companies like yours. If you don't approve this return right now, I want your manager's name and I'll be leaving reviews about this experience on every single cycling forum I can find.

That won't be necessary, Mr. Sterling. I can absolutely resolve this for you. I see here the helmet was delivered 71 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. I am approving the full refund for you right now.
Wait, really? It's approved? Just like that?

Yes, of course. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities, and that means having gear you're happy with. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to the address on file. And for the trouble with the website and the color discrepancy, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 goodwill credit to your account for a future purchase. That's our apology for the frustration.
Oh. A credit too? Well... okay then. I appreciate that. That's... better service than I expected. Thank you, David.
You are very welcome, Mr. Sterling. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. This works. Thank you.
Excellent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
